name: Riptide (Undersea Privateer)
text:
Requirements You're in Anchor Stance, and your target is within 5 feet of the edge of a water vehicle or already in the water.

---
You swirl water around you to make a current that pulls creatures closer. Attempt an Athletics check check against the Fortitude DC of a creature within 20 feet. If the creature is willing, you increase your degree of success by one (turning a failure into a success and a success into a critical success).

---
Critical Success The target is pulled 10 feet toward you.

Success The target is pulled 5 feet toward you.

Critical Failure Your movements cause you to be Off-Guard until the beginning of your next turn.
